text: 【房地产信贷新规落地，银行资产质量有望改善，银行ETF博时(159253)跟踪指数涨近1%】2026年8月31日早盘，银行ETF博时(159253)跟踪指数中证银行指数(399986)上涨0.90%，成分股北京银行上涨4.13%，齐鲁银行上涨3.49%，邮储银行上涨2.81%，中国银行上涨2.75%，长沙银行上涨1.78%。
text_en: [New real estate credit rules take effect, bank asset quality expected to improve; Bosera Bank ETF (159253) tracking index up nearly 1%] On the morning of August 31, 2026, the CSI Bank Index (399986) tracked by Bosera Bank ETF (159253) rose 0.90%, with constituents Bank of Beijing up 4.13%, Qilu Bank up 3.49%, Postal Savings Bank up 2.81%, Bank of China up 2.75%, and Bank of Changsha up 1.78%.
